data: Which of the lines in the right graph represent the data set extracted by the SRPRS method?

The question asks which line represents the data set extracted by the SRPRS method. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the degree distributions of entity alignment datasets extracted by different methods. The lines in the graph are labeled with the names of the methods used for extraction. 

Looking at the right graph (b), there is a solid black line labeled "SRPRS (normal)." This indicates that this line corresponds to the data set extracted by the SRPRS method. Therefore, the line representing the data set extracted by the SRPRS method in the right graph is the solid black line.
